title: ATTEMPT AT ARBITRATION
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Published 1900 by George Q. Cannon & Sons. Detailed history of the Missouri period persecutions of the Latter-day Saints.

footnotes.text: Abridged from Millennial Star, Volume 15, p. 81.

Joseph states that seven were drowned, (see History of Joseph Smith, Millennial Star, Volume 15, p. 83); but the History of Clay County, published in St. Louis by the National Historical Society, says that only five were drowned.
